actual: Several non-QE-experiment MCP wrappers still default to large responses or lack shared response truncation: backend/mcp/common.py has no max-response guard, qe_archive_list_runs/list_skips default to 100, qe_archive_query_factor_importance defaults to 50 on a heavy JOIN, research_list_artifact_refs/research_list_backtest_records default to 100, and validation issue/bug list wrappers can return large per-item payloads.
closure_requirements: Default MCP list/search tools return compact or bounded responses without removing explicit detail/full paths.
QE archive MCP wrappers use lower summary-first default limits for high-risk list/query tools.
Research MCP gateway client has a response-size guardrail consistent with other AIstock MCP clients.
Shared MCP response-size guards return structured requires_refinement guidance without partial previews or hard-truncated data.
Validation MCP bug/issue list/search tools expose compact defaults and full mode on demand.
Run required verification plans and keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
